propensity.scaling: full-cohort mean zero and population SD one

ato_score.name: algebraically_stabilized_unclipped_overlap_aipw
ato_score.rationale: For the overlap estimand, h*A/e=A(1-e) and h*(1-A)/(1-e)=(1-A)e. The algebraically simplified score contains no inverse propensity term and remains finite at numerical propensities near zero or one. This preserves the exact covariate balance induced by the unpenalized logistic overlap weights.

locked_estimator.population: HR-positive/HER2-negative day-180 landmark survivors with no documented chemotherapy initiation by day 180 and ascertainable chemotherapy start timing.
locked_estimator.treatment: Hormone therapy initiated during days 0-180 versus no initiation by day 180.
locked_estimator.propensity: Full-sample unpenalized logistic MLE on the locked 13 baseline variables, refitted in every patient bootstrap.
locked_estimator.censoring: Exact Candidate V9 cross-fitted discrete-time regularized logistic censoring model with G-min=0.10.
locked_estimator.outcome_regression: Exact Candidate V9 cross-fitted arm-specific bounded RidgeCV model on the IPCW-RMST pseudo-outcome.
locked_estimator.score: Algebraically stabilized unclipped overlap AIPW score.

disclosure: Post hoc design-stage amendment. Candidate V9 prompted a chemotherapy-sequencing audit. The strict V10 population was frozen before effect estimation. A regularized cross-fitted propensity failed the balance gate. An unpenalized logistic propensity achieved exact raw overlap balance but failed pointwise minimum/maximum propensity gates. Because the overlap AIPW score does not require inverse propensity weighting after algebraic simplification, Stage 25C replaces pointwise endpoint gates with tail-mass, overlap-mass, ESS, balance, and bootstrap-feasibility gates and locks the unclipped stabilized score before any V10 outcome effect is computed.
